verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a hosted fintech SaaS (corporate cards, global payments, expense management). For a software platform, asking whether it can be self-hosted is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a self-hosted, on-premise or open-source deployment of the core product; it describes only hosted services, APIs, webhooks and an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
